hero.headline: Understand your money month without the spreadsheet noise.
hero.body: MiniFT gives you one calm workspace for accounts, transactions, budgets, recurring activity, imports, and reports, so every month is easier to read and easier to control.

value.headline: A finance workspace that stays readable.
value.description: MiniFT is built for people who want control without turning personal finance into a second job.

month.title: Understand the month
month.description: See income, expenses, net cash flow, and budget pressure in one place instead of hunting through separate notes and spreadsheets.

spreadsheets.title: Replace spreadsheet drift
spreadsheets.description: Keep accounts, transfers, recurring entries, and categories structured so the numbers do not become stale after a few weeks.

review.title: Approve before it counts
review.description: Optional imports are review-first. You stay in control of what becomes a real transaction in your workspace.

howItWorks.headline: Three steps to a clearer month
howItWorks.description: Start manually, add automation when it helps, and keep your month readable from the dashboard.
howItWorks.step1Body: Add cash, bank, credit, or loan accounts. Set them up once and keep balances separated in one place.
howItWorks.step2Body: Enter transactions manually, use recurring rules, or review optional Gmail imports before they become records.
howItWorks.step3Body: Check budgets, review reports, and see your net cash flow in one quiet, focused workspace.

faq.description: A few practical answers about privacy, imports, and how MiniFT fits into your routine.

free.question: Is MiniFT free?
free.answer: MiniFT is currently free to use while the product is being built and refined. If paid plans are added later, the core value and limits will be explained clearly.

bank.question: Does MiniFT access my bank?
bank.answer: No. MiniFT does not ask for online banking credentials and does not connect directly to your bank account portal.

manual.question: Can I use MiniFT manually?
manual.answer: Yes. Manual tracking is a first-class workflow. You can add accounts, transactions, transfers, budgets, and recurring entries without connecting any integration.

gmail.question: What does the Gmail integration read?
gmail.answer: If enabled, Gmail access is read-only and intended to detect supported bank alert emails so MiniFT can create transaction imports for your review.

data.question: Can I delete or export my data?
data.answer: You can manage records inside the app today. Full account deletion and user data export are planned as part of the production readiness roadmap.

mobile.question: Is MiniFT mobile friendly?
mobile.answer: Yes. The app is designed to work on desktop and mobile web.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how MiniFT collects, uses, and protects information when you use the personal finance tracker.

collection.title: Information we collect
collection.body1: MiniFT collects the information you provide to create and use your account, including your email address, authentication data, user preferences, accounts, transactions, transfers, budgets, recurring rules, exchange-rate settings, and other financial records you choose to enter.
collection.body2: If you connect Gmail, MiniFT may process read-only Gmail data needed to identify bank alert emails and turn them into transaction imports for your review. The app also processes technical information such as session cookies, request metadata, and diagnostic logs needed to operate and secure the service.

use.title: How we use information
use.body1: We use information to provide the MiniFT workspace, authenticate users, maintain sessions, send verification and password emails, process optional Gmail imports, display reports, apply user preferences, troubleshoot issues, and protect the service from abuse.
use.body2: MiniFT is a personal finance tool. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use your financial records for advertising profiling.

sharing.title: Service providers and integrations
sharing.body1: MiniFT may rely on infrastructure, database, hosting, logging, and email providers to operate the service. Email delivery may be handled by Resend. If you enable Google or Gmail features, Google handles the authorization flow and provides the data needed for that integration.
sharing.body2: These providers are used only to support the service. Their own terms and privacy policies may also apply when you interact with them.

controls.title: Your choices and controls
controls.body1: You can update or delete financial records inside the app, disconnect Gmail from the integrations page, and stop using the service at any time.
controls.body2: To request help with account access, data deletion, or privacy questions, contact Addison Reyes at addison.amin@gmail.com.

security.title: Security and retention
security.body1: MiniFT uses practical safeguards such as HttpOnly authentication cookies, hashed secrets, and access controls designed to protect user data. No online service can guarantee perfect security.
security.body2: We keep information as long as needed to provide the service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, improve reliability, and enforce these policies.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service describe the rules for using MiniFT. By using the app, you agree to these terms.

service.title: The service
service.body1: MiniFT is a personal finance tracking tool for accounts, transactions, budgets, reports, recurring entries, and optional integrations. It is provided to help you organize information you enter or approve.
service.body2: MiniFT does not provide financial, legal, accounting, investment, or tax advice. You are responsible for decisions you make based on your data.

accounts.title: Accounts and responsibility
accounts.body1: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for the accuracy of the information you enter, import, approve, edit, or delete in MiniFT.
accounts.body2: You must not use the service to store unlawful content, access another person's account, interfere with the service, or attempt to bypass security controls.

use.title: Acceptable use
use.body1: Use MiniFT only for lawful personal or permitted purposes. Do not abuse integrations, send automated traffic that harms the service, reverse engineer hosted infrastructure, or use the service in a way that violates applicable law.
use.body2: We may suspend or limit access if we reasonably believe an account is being misused, is creating security risk, or is violating these terms.

availability.title: Availability and warranty
availability.body1: MiniFT may change, pause, or discontinue features over time. We try to keep the service reliable, but availability is not guaranteed.
availability.body2: The software and service are provided as is, without warranties to the fullest extent allowed by law. The open-source project is licensed separately under the MIT License.

law.title: Governing law and contact
law.body1: These terms are governed by the laws of the Dominican Republic, without regard to conflict-of-law rules, unless mandatory consumer protection laws require otherwise.
law.body2: Questions about these terms can be sent to Addison Reyes at addison.amin@gmail.com.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how MiniFT uses cookies and similar browser storage to operate the app.

what.title: What cookies are
what.body1: Cookies are small pieces of data stored by your browser. Similar technologies, such as local storage, may also be used to remember preferences on your device.
what.body2: MiniFT uses these technologies primarily to keep the app secure, maintain sessions, and remember basic preferences.

essential.title: Essential authentication cookies
essential.body1: MiniFT uses essential HttpOnly cookies for access and refresh sessions. These cookies help keep you signed in and protect authentication tokens from client-side scripts.
essential.body2: These cookies are required for authenticated areas of the app. Cookie names may vary by deployment because the backend allows operators to configure them.

thirdParty.title: Analytics and third-party cookies
thirdParty.body1: MiniFT does not currently use advertising cookies or tracking cookies for behavioral ads.
thirdParty.body2: If you use Google or Gmail integration features, Google may use its own cookies or account session as part of the authorization flow. Google controls those cookies under its own policies.

controls.title: Your controls
controls.body1: You can delete or block cookies through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may prevent sign-in, session refresh, or protected pages from working correctly.
controls.body2: Questions about cookies can be sent to Addison Reyes at addison.amin@gmail.com.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect Gmail so MiniFT can read bank alert emails, parse supported bank notifications, and import transactions without asking for banking credentials.
integrations.safeTitle: MiniFT only reads bank alert emails
integrations.safeBody: MiniFT only processes automatic bank alert emails. It never accesses your online banking, never asks for banking credentials, and only uses Gmail read access to detect activity and help you capture spending faster.
integrations.connectedNotice: Gmail is connected and the first sync has already been scheduled.
integrations.notConfigured: This deployment is not configured for Google OAuth and token encryption yet. Add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URL, and GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY to enable the integration.
integrations.automationBody: MiniFT learns account, merchant, and category rules from each approval. Ready imports stay one click away in the queue, and you can optionally auto-approve future high-confidence imports.
integrations.notConnectedBody: Connect your Gmail account to let MiniFT review supported bank alerts and create imports for compatible banks.
integrations.scopeDescription: The integration intentionally requests the minimum scope needed to read bank alert emails and nothing else.
integrations.gmailReadonlyBody: MiniFT reads alert messages so it can parse transactions. It does not send email, modify Gmail labels, or touch your banking portal.
integrations.reviewWorkflowBody: MiniFT now learns from every approval. High-confidence imports can stay ready for one-click approval, and you can enable optional auto-approve once you trust the learned account and category rules.
integrations.consentSubtitle: MiniFT only reads automatic bank alert emails. It never accesses your online banking.
integrations.consentBody: You will be redirected to Google and asked to grant read-only Gmail access so MiniFT can process bank alert emails and turn them into reviewable imports.
